name: Walter Graham
source:
"It's me, Walter/(Y/N). Walter/(Y/N) Graham. I moved to Highwell recently and since then, I've been writing on this journal. I'm also on a quest to discover my pendant's origin and importance (kind of.)

Well, I'm not really the type to keep track of my daily life, but I've been told this could benefit me, especially with my forgetfulness.

Hmm, I guess I'm obsessed with bottled milk right now, and I sort of dislike peanut butter, but I can't seem to stop eating them somehow..."

From: Walter's Journal
